description: Use this when the user wants a 501 or 301 darts leg scored: "score my 501 leg", "I threw T20 T20 T20, then S20, then out on D10", "darts scorer, double out". Send each visit to the oche as a turn of up to 3 darts (formats: S20, D16, T19, SB, DB, or 0). Applies standard bust rules (a bust scores nothing and the turn ends; darts after a finish are ignored; double-out requires a double or inner bull to finish unless double_out is false). Returns remaining, per-turn detail, busts, darts thrown, the three-dart average, a checkout suggestion when one exists, and a CSV of the leg. It is not for cricket or around-the-clock variants, and it does not track multi-leg matches — one leg per call.

double_out.description: Require a double (or inner bull) to finish, e.g. true for a double-out leg. Default true.

turns.description: Turns in order; each turn has up to 3 darts. A new entry per visit, e.g. one turn containing T20 and D20.

darts.description: Darts in order, e.g. ["T20","T20","D10"]. Formats: S/D/T + number (S20, D16, T19), SB for the outer bull, DB for the inner bull, and 0 for a miss. Invalid tokens are named in the error (first 30 characters for long values).
